<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
The repetition logic is now clearer.

`pickTemplateForSlot` cycles through the meal pool using `(dayIndex + mealIndex + offset) % poolLen`. Because each meal type starts at a different offset, the same template can be selected for multiple days in sequence. This explains why identical meals appear across consecutive days.

Rotation does occur across days. Identical daily meals likely stem from four causes: a small pool wrapping back to the same recipe, aliases mapping different names to the same recipe, exclusions narrowing the pool to one template, or portion scaling making distinct recipes look identical.

A small pool length would directly cause identical meals. For example, a two-item vegan breakfast pool repeats every second day. The `resolveSimpleStartLocalSlot` alias mapping may also be forcing different agent names into the same library recipe.
</details></think>

True daily duplication instead requires a single-item recipe pool, repeated fallback to the same alternative name, or a bug preventing dayIndex from incrementing.

# Audit: PlanViewer replace/pin + meal planning pipeline

## 1. „Nahradit jiným“ (Replace)

| Layer | Path | Function(s) | Persists to DB? |
|-------|------|-------------|-----------------|
| **UI handler** | `c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\body-mind-on\components\PlanViewer.js` | `handleSwap()` (~L1221), swap modal confirm (~L1717–1719) | **No** |
| **API actually called** | `c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\body-mind-on\pages\api\recipe.js` | `handler` (GET) via `getRecipeForDish()` (~L553) | **No** |
| **API exists but unused** | `c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\body-mind-on\pages\api\onboarding\replace-meal.js` | `handler`, `getDefaultQuery()` | **No** (not called from PlanViewer) |

**Flow today:**
1. Click → `handleSwap()` builds query like `"breakfast alternativa, do 500 kcal"`.
2. `GET /api/recipe?dish=...` → OpenAI generates HTML alternative (`pages/api/recipe.js`).
3. User confirms „Nahradit toto jídlo v plánu“ → `setMealOverrides({ [`${dayIndex}_${mealIndex}`]: { title, content } })`.
4. `mealOverrides` is React state only — affects display + shopping list (`lib/shoppingListBuilder.js`), **not** `ai_generated_plans.structured_plan_json` or `plan_html`.

**`replace-meal.js` status:** `SPOONACULAR_REPLACE_MEAL_LIVE = false` — returns placeholder `Jídlo (neověřeno)` without Spoonacular. Dead path from PlanViewer.

---

## 2. „Zahrnout do dalšího týdne“ (Pin)

| Layer | Path | Function(s) | Persists to DB? |
|-------|------|-------------|-----------------|
| **UI** | `components\PlanViewer.js` | `handleTogglePin()` (~L660), `isPinned()` (~L655), `normalizeMealTextForPin()` (~L446) | — |
| **Load pins** | `components\PlanViewer.js` | `useEffect` → `GET /api/meal-pins` (~L581–598) | reads DB |
| **API** | `pages\api\meal-pins.js` | `handler`, `normalizeMealText()` | **Yes** |
| **DB** | `supabase\migrations\20260307_user_meal_pins.sql` | table `user_meal_pins` | `UNIQUE(user_id, meal_type, meal_text)` |

**Pin persistence: YES** — `POST` upserts/deletes in `user_meal_pins` via `supabaseServer` (service role, not user JWT RLS).

**Pin used in next plan generation: NO**
- `user_meal_pins` is only referenced in: `meal-pins.js`, delete/reconcile scripts, migration.
- `lib\generatePlan.js` has `pinnedMeals` in `buildUserPrompt()` / `buildMealsOnlyPrompt()` but **nothing loads pins from DB** and passes them.
- `lib\unifiedPlanPipeline.js` → `planOrchestrator` → `SimpleMealPlannerAgent` — **no pin integration**.
- `.cursor/plans/jídelníček_zapínání_jídel_krok_za_krokem_ab1d379b.plan.md` step 3 (wire pins into generation) is **not implemented**.

---

## 3. `pages/api/onboarding/replace-meal.js`

- **Method:** POST only.
- **Inputs:** `date`, `meal_type`, optional `hint_query`, `body_metrics`, `targets`, `plan_id`.
- **Live path:** paused (`SPOONACULAR_REPLACE_MEAL_LIVE = false`).
- **Would use:** `getMealData()` → Spoonacular, `mapSpoonacularRecipe`, Czech title translation.
- **Does not write** to any plan table — returns JSON `{ ok, meal }` only.
- **Not wired** to PlanViewer (viewer uses `/api/recipe` instead).

---

## 4. `pages/api/meal-pins.js`

- **GET:** auth Bearer → `select meal_type, meal_text from user_meal_pins where user_id = ?`
- **POST:** `{ action: 'add'|'remove', meal_type, meal_text }` → normalize (strip parens suffix, diacritics, max 200 chars) → upsert/delete → return fresh `pins` array.
- **Auth:** `supabaseServer.auth.getUser(token)`.

---

## 5. `SimpleMealPlannerAgent` — 7 days & repetition

**File:** `c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\body-mind-on\lib\services\simpleMealPlannerAgent.js`

| Function | Role |
|----------|------|
| `buildSimpleStartMealSkeleton()` | Main export — builds 7-day skeleton |
| `pickTemplateForSlot()` | Picks template per day/slot |
| `mealTypesForCount()` | 2–4 slots: breakfast, lunch, dinner, [snack] |
| `resolveTargets()` / `resolveMealsPerDay()` / `dietKey()` | Calories, diet pool |
| `START_MEAL_TEMPLATES` | Per-diet pools (standard / vegetarian / vegan) |

**7-day build:**
```javascript
for (dayIndex = 0..6) {
  for each meal type (mi) {
    mealTpl = pickTemplateForSlot(pool, dayIndex, mi, exclusions, type)
    target_kcal = slotTargetKcal(daily, mealsPerDay, weightKey)
  }
}
```

**Repetition logic (`pickTemplateForSlot`):**
- Index: `(dayIndex + mi + offset) % pool.length` — **deterministic rotation**, not random.
- No cap on how often same `name_cs` appears per week.
- If all templates fail exclusions → `cheeseFreeAlternativeName(mealType)` → **same fallback every day** for that slot type.
- Agent instructions explicitly allow repetition: *„jídla se mohou opakovat“*, *„opakovatelnost > složitost“*.

**Downstream resolve:** `lib\services\planOrchestrator.js` → `generateStructuredPlan()` calls agent skeleton when `simpleStartMode`, then `resolveMeals()` → `lib\recipesCatalog.js` → `resolveSimpleStartLocalSlot()` in `lib\startSimpleMealFilter.js`.

---

## 6. `lib/nutrition/portionScaling.js` — daily calorie scaling

| Function | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `MEAL_WEIGHTS` | 3-meal: 30/40/30%; 4-meal: 25/35/30/10% |
| `slotTargetKcal(dailyTarget, mealsPerDay, mealType)` | Slot kcal from daily target |
| `planMealTypeToWeightKey()` | breakfast→snidane, lunch→obed, etc. |
| `scaleMealToTarget(recipe, target, opts)` | Portion multiplier; `START_MAX_SCALE = 3.0` in simple start |
| `pickClosestCatalogRow()` / `pickFromTopKCatalogRow()` | Catalog pick by kcal proximity + seeded variety |
| `boostDayMealsToCalorieTarget()` | Raise portions to ≥85% daily target |
| `balanceDayMealsToCalorieTarget()` | ±15% tolerance (used in simple start) |
| `applyPortionScaleToStructuredMeal()` | Re-scale macros on portion change |

**Simple start:** `resolveSimpleStartLocalSlot` scales library/fallback meals to `slotTargetKcal`, then `resolveMealsFromCatalog` runs `boostDayMealsToCalorieTarget` + `balanceDayMealsToCalorieTarget` per day.

**Note:** `slotSalt` passed to `resolveSimpleStartLocalSlot` is **ignored** on the library path — no seeded pick for START library meals.

---

## 7. `lib/simpleStartRecipeLibrary.js` — meal pool

| Export | Role |
|--------|------|
| `SIMPLE_START_RECIPES` | ~19 hardcoded recipes (breakfast×4, lunch×6, dinner×4, snack×5) |
| `findSimpleStartRecipeByTitle()` | Lookup by normalized title + meal type |
| `resolveSimpleStartTitle()` | Aliases (e.g. „Cottage talíř“ → „Cottage s pečivem“, „Sendvič se šunkou“ → „Šunka, pečivo a zelenina“) |
| `buildSimpleStartLibraryMeal()` | Structured meal object with `catalog_source: 'simple_start_library'` |

Agent has **more** templates than the library (e.g. 6 standard breakfasts vs 4 library breakfasts). Unmapped names fall through to `buildStartSafeFallbackMeal()` in `startSimpleMealFilter.js`.

---

## Root cause: identical / repetitive daily meals

| Cause | Mechanism |
|-------|-----------|
| **By design** | Agent instructions prioritize repeatability over variety |
| **Deterministic rotation** | `pickTemplateForSlot` — same inputs → same week every regeneration |
| **Small pools** | Vegan: 2 breakfasts / 2 snacks → repeats every 2 days |
| **Title aliases** | Multiple agent names collapse to one `SIMPLE_START_RECIPES` entry |
| **Exclusion fallback** | All pool items blocked → `cheeseFreeAlternativeName()` → **identical meal every day** for that slot |
| **No week-level dedup** | `usedCatalogIds` only in non–simple-start catalog path; START ignores cross-day usage |
| **`slotSalt` unused** | Library resolve is 1:1 from agent `name_cs`, no per-slot randomness |
| **Shared cross-slot names** | e.g. „Jogurt s ovocem“ in breakfast + snack pools |

---

## What to change for variability (max 2× same, 3 breakfast types, etc.)

### A. `simpleMealPlannerAgent.js` — `pickTemplateForSlot` / `buildSimpleStartMealSkeleton`
- Track `usedCount[name_cs]` per `mealType` across the 7 days.
- Skip template if `usedCount >= 2` (max 2× per week).
- Enforce minimum distinct breakfasts: e.g. pick 3 different breakfast templates first, then fill remaining days with allowed repeats.
- Replace `(dayIndex + mi) % len` with seeded shuffle of pool per week (`user_id` + `valid_from`).

### B. `startSimpleMealFilter.js` — `resolveSimpleStartLocalSlot`
- Use `slotSalt` / week seed when multiple library rows match same title.
- Pass `usedTitlesThisWeek` from `resolveMealsFromCatalog` to avoid resolving same `display_name_cs` >2×.

### C. `recipesCatalog.js` — `resolveMealsFromCatalog` (simple start branch)
- Maintain `usedMealTitles: Map<mealType, Map<title, count>>` across days.
- When count ≥ 2, re-pick from agent pool (needs agent re-call or expanded skeleton metadata).

### D. `simpleStartRecipeLibrary.js`
- Add missing agent templates to `SIMPLE_START_RECIPES` (reduce fallback collisions).
- Review `SIMPLE_START_TITLE_ALIASES` — aliases **reduce** visible variety.

### E. `dietaryExclusions.js` — `cheeseFreeAlternativeName`
- Return **array of alternatives** rotated by `dayIndex`, not one fixed name per slot type.

### F. Pin feature (complete step 3 from plan)
- In `generatePlanForEmailViaUnified` / `planOrchestrator`: load `user_meal_pins` for `user_id`.
- Pass pinned `{ meal_type, meal_text }` into skeleton builder to **force** those meals into next week’s slots.
- Optionally clear pins after successful generation.

### G. Replace feature (if DB persistence wanted)
- Wire PlanViewer to `POST /api/onboarding/replace-meal` (when Spoonacular unpaused) **or** persist override via new API patching `structured_plan_json` on `ai_generated_plans`.
- Today replace is **session-only UI** — lost on refresh.
